written.myAnswer: A large foot spreads the animal’s weight over a larger area, reducing the pressure on the ground.
A smaller foot area produces greater pressure for the same force, helping the feet grip the ground while running.
Pebbles reduce the contact area of the foot, creating high pressure that causes pain.
Force is a push or pull, measured in newtons (N). Pressure is normal force per unit area, measured in pascals (Pa).
Maximum pressure = 50 N ÷ 0.005 m² = 1.0 × 10⁴ Pa; minimum pressure = 50 N ÷ 0.020 m² = 2.5 × 10³ Pa.
